description:
This process starts with a department outlining its objectives for the upcoming period, such as hiring, equipment needs, or marketing efforts.
The team drafts a plan that includes cost estimates and justifications for the budget requested.
The plan is first reviewed in a strategic alignment meeting to ensure it aligns with broader organizational goals.
Following this, the finance department performs a detailed review to assess the budget's feasibility.
The plan may undergo several rounds of review and possible adjustments based on feedback from these reviews.
Each adjustment is documented and approved by necessary stakeholders.
Once the final version of the budget is approved, the budget is officially allocated to the department.
The process ends when the budget is distributed, and the department begins implementing its plan.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  xmlns:tns="https://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning"
                  id="Definitions_BudgetPlanning"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/budget-planning">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_BudgetPlanning" name="Department Budget Planning" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" name="Budget planning begins">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OutlineObjectives" name="Outline department objectives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Outline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DraftPlan" name="Draft budget plan with estimates and justifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outline_Draft</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_StrategicReview" name="Review plan in strategic alignment meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Draft_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StakeholderApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinanceReview" name="Review budget feasibility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinanceReview_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReviewOutcome" name="Further adjustment needed?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinanceReview_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_Adjustment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_FinalApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DocumentAdjustment" name="Document plan adjustment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_Adjustment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Adjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveAdjustment" name="Approve adjustment with necessary stakeholders">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Adjustment_StakeholderApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StakeholderApproval_StrategicReview</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" name="Approve final budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_FinalApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateBudget" name="Allocate budget to department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Allocate_Implement</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BeginImplementation" name="Begin implementing plan">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Allocate_Implement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed" name="Budget distributed and implementation begun">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Implement_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Outline" sourceRef="StartEvent_BudgetPlanning" targetRef="Task_OutlineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outline_Draft" sourceRef="Task_OutlineObjectives" targetRef="Task_DraftPlan"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Draft_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_DraftPlan" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StrategicReview_FinanceReview" sourceRef="Task_StrategicReview" targetRef="Task_FinanceReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinanceReview_Decision" sourceRef="Task_FinanceReview" targetRef="Gateway_ReviewOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Adjustment" name="Adjustment needed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewOutcome" targetRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">adjustmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_FinalApproval" name="No further adjustment needed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReviewOutcome" targetRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not adjustmentNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Adjustment_StakeholderApproval" sourceRef="Task_DocumentAdjustment" targetRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StakeholderApproval_StrategicReview" sourceRef="Task_ApproveAdjustment" targetRef="Task_StrategicReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalApproval_Allocate" sourceRef="Task_ApproveFinalBudget" targetRef="Task_AllocateBudget"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Implement" sourceRef="Task_AllocateBudget" targetRef="Task_BeginImplementation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Implement_End" sourceRef="Task_BeginImplementation" targetRef="EndEvent_BudgetDistributed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
